scope: Fixed-key caption repair pilot; no selector updates
auxiliary_prompt: These source video frames are in chronological order. What visible actions or changes occur, and in what order? checkpoint_policy: Common fixed-key caption CE on 16 previous validation windows and four new validation windows. Retain the lowest mean CE checkpoint, including epoch zero. Report free-generation semantic metrics separately.
adoption_gate: On the six new test windows, complete fact and event counts must be no lower than both base and previous joint, with no more error windows; the known 14-window diagnostic must not regress on these counts. This small non-independent pilot cannot prove broad improvement.
